senses.gloss:
1. दी दी (cf. डी), i. 4, Par. To soar, to fly (ved.).
 --Cf. probably δίνη, δινέω, perhaps δίω, δίεμαι.

2. दी दी, anomal. ii. 3, दीदी, Par., Ātm. To shine (ved.).
 --Cf. δέαται, δέατο, probably also δῆλος.

3. दी दी, i. 4, Ātm. To waste, to go to ruin.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. दीन,
 1. Scanty (ved.).
 2. Afflicted, wretched, Man. 9, 238.
 --Comp.
